name: Gearbox
text:
Add SD3.5-Ultra’s motion-refiner to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It directly attacks motion blur—the biggest visible flaw in current outputs—with a temporal fix that no spatial upscaler can match. The trade-off is hidden compute cost: if the black-box model adds latency beyond 0.5% of the total pipeline time, we’ll drop it and revisit InstantX’s upscaler.

name: Torque
text: Depth-aware upscaling won’t touch motion blur—it’s a spatial band-aid, not a temporal fix. The real risk with SD3.5-Ultra’s motion-refiner is black-box latency: if it adds hidden compute, it could wipe out the 0.5% gain before you even measure quality. Run a 100-frame clip through both, log PSNR *and* end-to-end latency—if neither beats the baseline, drop both and test a lighter temporal model like FILM or XVFI++ instead.

name: Dynamo
text:
DECISION: Skip both InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler and SD3.5-Ultra’s motion-refiner—neither targets EXCAVA’s core motion blur flaw with a provable 0.5% gain.

Result: A 100-frame clip tested through both models must show PSNR drop vs. baseline; if neither outperforms current pipeline, scrap both. Owner: Torque.
